name: CLAUDE.md Review
title_zh: 审计 CLAUDE.md，揪出拖垮输出的四类病灶
tagline_zh: 当 Claude 反复重读同一段上下文、结果忽好忽坏时，别猜了。它专查模糊表述、未命名文件、过期事实和臃肿段落——。
tagline_en: When Claude keeps re-reading the same context and results swing wildly, stop guessing. It hunts vagueness.
desc_en: Audit a CLAUDE.md file for the patterns that actually degrade Claude Code's output — vagueness, unnamed files, stale facts, and bloat. Use when asked to review, audit, improve, shrink, or fix a CLAUDE.md, and when a project's results feel inconsistent or Claude keeps rediscovering the same context.
why_zh: 不是泛泛的『写得更好』，而是按四类已知劣化模式逐条扫描，每条给出可执行改法。机制上像 lint。
why_en: Not generic 'write better' advice—it scans against four known degradation patterns and gives actionable fixes per hit. Works.
limit_zh: 只审 CLAUDE.md 单文件，不碰其他配置或代码库；不自动改写，只输出诊断与建议；若你的 CLAUDE.md 本就。
limit_en: Audits CLAUDE.md only—no other configs or codebase. Diagnoses but never auto-edits. If your file is already minimal (<30 lines), few issues will.
